info.title: Knowledge graph L1: Health intervention API
info.description: What a recommendation is about, and the hinge to L2. Corresponds to the DAK component smart-base defines as HealthInterventions — today `id`, `description[x]` and `reference 1..* DublinCore`, i.e. a bibliographic citation with no recommendation behind it. This class is what that citation should resolve to. Corresponds to HealthInterventions: identifier = HealthInterventions.id and description = HealthInterventions.description[x]; not a Parent because HealthInterventions requires reference 1..* DublinCore, which in the graph is an edge to a publication rather than a field. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/health-intervention.
